IDAHO FISH & GAME
The Idaho Fish and Game website is undergoing maintenance
The Idaho Fish and Game website is currently unavailable. We apologize for the inconvenience, but in the meantime, we’ve compiled a list of resources to help you find everything you need to hunt, fish, and trap in Idaho.
Seasons and Rules Information
Big Game Seasons and Rules
Idaho Migratory Game Bird Seasons and Rules
Idaho Upland Game, Turkey, Furbearer Seasons and Rules
Idaho Moose, Bighorn Sheep, and Mountain Goat Seasons and Rules
Idaho Fishing Seasons and Rules
Nonresident Supplement for General Season Deer and Elk 2027
Open Meeting Notices & Agenda
Winter Feeding Advisory Committee: Meeting Notice | Agenda
Licensing & Mandatory Hunter Reporting
Licenses and tags can be bought online at GoOutdoorsIdaho.com, or through the Idaho Fish and Game mobile app.
They can also be purchased in person at a license vendor location, or Fish and Game regional offices during normal business hours.
Mandatory hunter reports may also be submitted through GoOutdoorsIdaho.com, or through the Idaho Fish and Game app.
Chronic Wasting Disease (CWD)
Information on CWD, including required testing rules, transport rules, drop-off locations, and who to contact for your testing results can be found here: [CWD Information 2027]
Ways to Contact Us
Idaho Fish and Game staff are available to answer your questions by visiting one of our offices or by phone.
Panhandle Regional Office – 2885 W. Kathleen Ave. Coeur d'Alene, (208) 769-1414
Clearwater Regional Office – 3316 16th St. Lewiston, (208) 799-5010
Southwest Regional Office – McCall: 555 Deinhard Lane McCall, (208) 634-8137
Southwest Regional Office – Nampa: 15950 N. Gate Blvd, Nampa, (208) 465-8465
Magic Valley Regional Office – 324 South 417 East - Suite 1, Jerome, (208) 324-4359
Southeast Regional Office – 1345 Barton Road, Pocatello, (208) 232-4703
Upper Snake Regional Office – 4279 Commerce Circle, Idaho Falls, (208) 525-7290
Salmon Regional Office – 99 Hwy. 93 N. Salmon, (208) 756-2271
Headquarters Office – 600 S. Walnut Street, Boise, (208) 334-3700
For licensing and mandatory hunter report questions, email us at Licenses@idfg.idaho.gov
For other website needs or information, please contact a regional office or email us website@idfg.idaho.gov
Other Resources & Services
Report Roadkill – Call an Idaho Fish and Game regional office.
View and Register for Hunter Education Courses In person | Hunter-Ed.com (online) | Recademics (online)
Report a Wildlife Crime – Call the Citizens Against Poaching line at (800) 632-5999
Submit a public record request – Complete this online form [Public Record Request]
Submit a data request – Email: idfgdatarequests@idfg.idaho.gov
Make a restitution payment – Access the payment portal [Make a payment]
To track tags through the Tag You’re It program – Email: tagyoureit@idfg.idaho.gov
For Fisheries permit information, including Fishing Tournament and Scientific Collecting Permits – Call 208-334-3791
